advancements.rotp_nextalbum.get_aja_ston: Obtain a Super Aja Stone in any form.
item.rotp_nextalbum.luck_pluck.reference: "Jonathan... I offer you the word engraved on my sword! Luck! And take this with you to your future! Pluck! "
item.nextalbum.luck_pluck.tooltips: Has same enchantment capabilities with a golden sword and a longer attack range. Additionally, you can use the Hamon action, which can only be used unarmed, while holding this item.
item.rotp_nextalbum.aja_stone_necklace.r: "This is it... Nature's perfect miracle crystal. Without a single imperfection! The Super Aja!"
item.nextalbum.aja_stone_necklace.toolti: When equipped, this allows you to press %s+%s to unleash a beam attack with effects, damage, and cooldowns identical to the Super Aja item.
item.nextalbum.mista_suit.tooltips: Each suit piece provides +15% protection against projectile and bullet damage.
